Royal Enfield Himalayan 27

OPERATION OF CONTROLS

CAUTION

 In case of prolonged stoppage of vehicle, please turn

off ignition key to avoid discharge of battery.

HAZARD LIGHT SWITCH 

 Press the hazard button to hazard blinking ON.

CAUTION

 Hazard flashing will create a strain on battery. Do not

use hazard warning for longer period unless necessary.

Methods to activate hazard flasher:

 Ignition switch ON, press the hazard switch. Hazard

will work unless manual deactivation (OFF).

 Ignition switch ON, press the hazard switch

hazard will start working - Ignition switch OFF

- Hazard will keep working for a duration of 30 minutes 

- Unless manual deactivation (OFF).

 Hazard flasher cannot be activated in ignition switch

OFF condition.

28 Royal Enfield Himalayan

OPERATION OF CONTROLS

WARNING

 Turn signals do not work when the hazard light switch

is “ON”.

 All the trafficator lamps will flash simultaneously.

HORN 

Press the horn button to sound horn.

HIGH BEAM/LOW BEAM SWITCH 

 When the headlamp is in “ON” condition High / Low

beam will be selected by toggling the switch. High

beam indicator tell tale located in instrument cluster

will glow when high beam is selected.

visual_adjudication.finding: Item 6 Hazard switch points to the rider right-hand control, adjacent to item 5 Ignition/Engine kill switch.
visual_adjudication.scope: Finite original diagram and label relationship; not a rider-photo diagnosis.

visual_adjudication.finding: The hazard drawing has the triangle-marked hazard control on the same right-hand assembly. Ignition ON activation, OFF continuation for 30 minutes unless deactivated, OFF activation prohibition, prolonged-stop ignition-off and battery-strain cautions are retained.
visual_adjudication.scope: Hazard control identity and stated activation conditions/cautions.

visual_adjudication.finding: The warning states turn signals do not work while hazards are ON and trafficator lamps flash simultaneously.
visual_adjudication.scope: Hazard warning continuation only; no repair process authorized.
